reel.caption:
Is your take-home lower this month, with no pay cut?

The EPF wage ceiling went up from ₹15,000 to ₹25,000, and October is the first full salary month under it.
If your PF was worked out on the old ₹15,000 cap, 12% is now taken on more of your basic + DA.
Example from the reports: ₹20,000 basic + DA → PF rises from ₹1,800 to ₹2,400, so ₹600 less in hand. At ₹25,000 it's ₹1,200 more.
That extra amount goes into your PF balance; it is savings, not a deduction you lose.

Did your October payslip change? What did you notice first?

Sources: two personal-finance news reports on the EPF wage ceiling change (Sept–Oct 2026).

For education only. Not investment advice.
